# Support

Knemora Community is maintained as an open-source project without a support SLA.

- Use GitHub Discussions, when enabled, for setup and usage questions.
- Use GitHub Issues for reproducible bugs and focused feature proposals.
- Use private vulnerability reporting for security issues; see `SECURITY.md`.

Include the Knemora version, operating system, deployment method, relevant sanitized logs, and
reproduction steps. Never post credentials, access tokens, private documents, model files, or
sensitive Wiki content.
